newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayernwerk takes 23.8 pct of Hungary Edasz off EDF.
newsitem.headline: Bayernwerk takes 23.8 pct of Hungary Edasz off EDF.

text.p: German utility Bayernwerk, a unit of VIAG AG, said on Friday it had taken over 23.8 percent of the shares of regional distributor Edasz from Electricite de France (EDF).
EDF itself will keep a 23.8 percent in Edasz and with this the planned partnership between Bayern and EDF has been realised, the company told a news conference.
"The joint participation is the expression of the cooperation in the European energy supply sector and in addition strengthens the two companies' ties with Hungary," a company spokesman said.
Both companies will now run EDASZ jointly, he added.
The spokesman declined to give figures on the purchase price.
Edasz, based in Gyor, is the second biggest electricity distributor in Hungary. In 1996 total turnover was 450 million marks and with a workforce of 2,489, it supplies 880,000 customers.
Bayernwerk already has stakes in another regional eletricity distributor, Dedasz as well as gas distributor Kogaz and Dedasz.
The regions covered by the three companies complement each other ideally, the spokesman added.
